عِظَةٌ : see 1. ―
-b2- [As a simple subst.,] it has for its pl. عِظَاتٌ: and is syn. with ↓ مَوْعِظَةٌ : (TA:) [the pl. of the latter is مَوَاعِظُ.] It is said in trad., لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ عِظَةً I will assuredly make thee a warning, or an example, to others. (TA.) And in the Kur, [ii. 276,] فَمَنْ جَآءَهُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ ↓ مَوْعِظَةٌ [But he to whom cometh an
exhortation, or an admonition, or warning, from his Lord]. (TA.) And ↓ القَتْلُوبِالمَوْعِظَةِ [The slaying by way of warning], mentioned in a trad., is when the innocent is slain in order that he who gives reason for suspicion may become warned. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
